doc.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024

title: Grandma Myrtle's shoe tree
summary: Chris called it a wapper dapper; it was a shoe tree used as a threat.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So I want to see if — this is just an aside — if you can confirm what your brothers said about discipline in the Brubeck home. And they mentioned Grandma Myrtle?
Yeah. What about her? Was it Chris?
He said that she had a wapper dapper.

Um hum. You know the old fashioned kind. Now they make them out of styrofoam or something. A shoe tree has a wedge on the end for the toe and something shaped like a heel that you put in shoes like you know if you’re Cary Grant’s valet you’d be doing that kind of thing and then a flexible steel band that connected the two.
And what would she use it for?
I remember it as a threat more than —
Yes I think that’s what they said. It was just something to bring up in case things were getting out of hand.
